newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 0.58 mln lbs luncheon meat for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 0.58 mln lbs luncheon meat for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it plans to buy 576,000 lbs of canned luncheon meat for use by recipients in Federal food assistance programs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-46 and be received by 1400 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Tuesday, October 15, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, October 18, 1996.
Shipments must be made between November 12 and 26.
